rationale: Independent reading before the producer rationale: held EO 8714 (6 FR 1517) designates in order the Fiscal Assistant Secretary, the senior Assistant Secretary on duty and the General Counsel to act for the Secretary of the Treasury during absence or sickness, and revokes EO 6202-B; no own term, no savings clause. Held EO 10586 (20 FR 361, signed Jan. 13, 1955) sets a new Treasury succession and states 'Executive Order No. 8714 of March 18, 1941, entitled "Designating Certain Officers To Act as Secretary of the Treasury in Case of Absence or Sickness of the Secretary", is hereby revoked.' Refutation attempts: right instrument (the revocation sits in EO 10586's own text before its signature, not in the neighbouring EO 10587/10588 extract); whole order revoked by number, date and title; no exception. D6: the only history events are the OFR/1989 'Revoked by EO 10586' leads; a corpus search finds EO 8714 named only in EO 10586 (other hits are FR doc numbers and page noise); EO 10941 sec. 2 later revokes EO 10586 without naming 8714, so no revival. No later event ignored. NO upheld. D6 answer: no later event ignored.
